evidence.reason: `update()` derives a deterministic outbox key and unconditionally replaces the row with a new `state="pending"` entry for every matching event. Thus a second `update()` with the same destination overwrites any already-`sent` row, discarding its sent status and retry metadata, and `drain()` will send the completed notification again. This is an implementation defect in existing update/outbox behavior, not merely a request to add hardening.
